title: FRAC-MAS: A Safe and Explainable Multi-Agent System for Fracture Diagnosis
abstract: arXiv:2608.28662v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fracture detection and its clinical interpretability see notable improvements when deep vision models are integrated with agentic AI architectures. While deep learning models achieve high diagnostic performance, their black-box nature limits clinical adoption. We propose FRAC-MAS, an agentic AI system for automated, explainable, and safe bone fracture detection. The framework combines a stacked ensemble of four vision models with conformal prediction to produce statistically grounded differential diagnoses, while a multi-agent workflow performs independent verification, retrieves clinical guidelines, and generates patient-friendly reports. A pipeline-depth ablation study confirms that our multi-agent critic triages 86.6% of cases into a high-confidence auto-confirmed cohort while escalating uncertain cases, outperforming a single-agent baseline. translated_title: FRAC-MAS：一种安全且可解释的骨折诊断多智能体系统
translated_abstract: 当深度视觉模型与智能体AI架构相集成时，骨折检测及其临床可解释性得到了显著改善。尽管深度学习模型具有较高的诊断性能，但其黑盒特性限制了临床应用。我们提出了FRAC-MAS，一个用于自动化、可解释且安全骨折检测的智能体AI系统。该框架将四个视觉模型的堆叠集成与共形预测相结合，以产生具有统计学依据的鉴别诊断，同时多智能体工作流执行独立验证、检索临床指南并生成患者友好的报告。流水线深度的消融研究证实，我们的多智能体批评者机制将86.6%的病例归入高置信度自动确认队列，同时将不确定的病例升级处理，性能优于单智能体基线。与Llama、MedGemma和Gemini的患者偏好研究进一步表明……（摘要内容不完整，此处截断）
tldr: FRAC-MAS提出了一种将四个视觉模型堆叠集成、共形预测与多智能体独立验证工作流相结合的安全可解释骨折自动诊断系统，可将86.6%的病例高置信度自动确认并升级不确定病例，同时生成患者友好的诊断报告。
